issues.label: Which law governs forum clause interpretation
issues.why: The court deemed dispositive whether Delaware or California law interprets a Delaware corporation's bylaw forum selection clause.

issues.label: Scope: whether clause covers inspection demand
issues.why: Enforceability turns on whether a shareholder inspection request falls within the clause's internal-affairs language.

issues.label: Whether inspection is an internal affair
issues.why: Application of the internal affairs doctrine determines if the clause governs and which state's substantive law applies.

issues.label: Enforceability under California public policy
issues.why: California courts refuse to enforce forum clauses that waive unwaivable statutory rights or violate public policy.

issues.label: Unwaivability of sections 1600/1601 rights
issues.why: Salamon claims his inspection rights are statutorily unwaivable and cannot be limited by bylaws.

issues.label: Comparison of California vs. Delaware inspection scope
issues.why: Whether Delaware Section 220 adequately protects Salamon's rights bears on public-policy deprivation.

issues.label: Application of California section 1600 absolute right
issues.why: The 5%-shareholder absolute right to inspect shareholder records may be treated differently from broader records.

issues.label: Section 1601 proper-purpose reasonableness
issues.why: Section 1601 requires a purpose reasonably related to shareholder interests, distinct from the absolute 1600 right.

issues.label: Effect of California principal place of business
issues.why: Section 1601 requires records open at a California principal office, implicating California's regulatory interest.

issues.label: Burden of proving proper vs. improper purpose
issues.why: Whether the demand is a share-buyback extortion scheme affects proper-purpose analysis under either statute.

issues.label: Effect of Delaware dismissal for lack of jurisdiction
issues.why: The Delaware court dismissed Orchid's action, undermining any stay premised on pending Delaware proceedings.

issues.label: Whether stay remains appropriate
issues.why: With the Delaware action dismissed, staying pending that proceeding may be moot or improper.

issues.label: Party asserting claim under clause
issues.why: The clause covers claims 'against the corporation,' raising whether Salamon's petition or Orchid's suit triggers it.

issues.label: Availability/forfeiture of arguments raised
issues.why: Salamon conceded certain points and misstated the bylaws, raising waiver/forfeiture of contentions.

issues.label: Standard of review on writ/stay order
issues.why: The reviewing court must apply the correct standard to the stay ruling and underlying legal determinations.

issues.label: Judicial notice of Delaware filings
issues.why: The court must properly consider judicially noticed Delaware proceedings and their preclusive or practical effect.

issues.label: Adequacy of alternative Delaware forum
issues.why: Enforcement requires the alternative forum to actually be available, questionable given the jurisdictional dismissal.

issues.label: Subsidiary records inspection rights
issues.why: Demands include Orchid Labs subsidiary records, raising whether inspection extends to subsidiaries.
